      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge" name="Review draft">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_05</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Sufficiency_Split" name="Is the draft sufficient?" default="Flow_07">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_05</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_06</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_07</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AddRequirements" name="Add additional requirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_06</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_08</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RefinedRequirements" name="Send additional requirements" messageRef="Msg_RefinedRequirements">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_08</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_09</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_RefinedDraftReceived" name="Refined draft received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_09</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RefinedDraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_RefinedDraft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialList" name="Create list of needed materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_07</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CategorizeMaterials" name="Categorize materials">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Split" name="Start ordering and friend requests">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_13</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_14</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_15</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderStoreA" name="Order materials" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_13</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_16</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderStoreB" name="Order materials" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_14</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_17</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_BuildRequest" name="Send build request" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_15</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_18</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrdersPlaced" name="Materials ordered">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_16</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_17</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Build_Split" name="Wait for each friend">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_18</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_19</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_20</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_HouseBuilt_F1" name="House built by friend 1">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_19</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_21</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_HouseBuilt_F1" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_HouseBuilt_F2" name="House built by friend 2">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_20</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_22</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_HouseBuilt_F2" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Build_Join" name="House is built">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_21</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_22</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_23</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Invitations" name="Send party invitations" messageRef="Msg_Invitation">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_23</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_24</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create attendee list">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_24</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_25</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuySnacks" name="Buy snacks">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_25</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_26</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Party prepared">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_26</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:textAnnotation id="Annotation_Parties">
      <bpmn:text>The description names several online stores and several friends; two representative pools are modeled for each.</bpmn:text>
    </bpmn:textAnnotation>
    <bpmn:association id="Assoc_Annotation" sourceRef="Annotation_Parties" targetRef="SendTask_OrderStoreA"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_Requirements" targetRef="Catch_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="Catch_DraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Sufficiency_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_06" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Sufficiency_Split" targetRef="Task_AddRequirements">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${draftSufficient == false}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_07" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Sufficiency_Split" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_AddRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_RefinedRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_RefinedRequirements" targetRef="Catch_RefinedDraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Catch_RefinedDraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialList" targetRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderStoreA"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderStoreB"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStoreA" targetRef="EndEvent_OrdersPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStoreB" targetRef="EndEvent_OrdersPlaced"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="SendTask_BuildRequest" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="Gateway_Build_Split" targetRef="Catch_HouseBuilt_F1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="Gateway_Build_Split" targetRef="Catch_HouseBuilt_F2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="Catch_HouseBuilt_F1" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Catch_HouseBuilt_F2" targetRef="Gateway_Build_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="Gateway_Build_Join" targetRef="SendTask_Invitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="SendTask_Invitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_26" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Friend1" name="Friend 1 house building" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_F1_BuildRequest" name="Build request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F1_Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_F1_BuildRequest" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_F1_BuildHouse" name="Build tree house">
      <bpmn:incoming>F1_Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F1_Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_F1_HouseBuilt" name="Report house built" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt">
      <bpmn:incoming>F1_Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F1_Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_F1_Invitation" name="Party invitation received">
      <bpmn:incoming>F1_Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F1_Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_F1_Invitation" messageRef="Msg_Invitation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_F1" name="Friend finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>F1_Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1_Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_F1_BuildRequest" targetRef="Task_F1_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1_Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_F1_BuildHouse" targetRef="SendTask_F1_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1_Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_F1_HouseBuilt" targetRef="Catch_F1_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F1_Flow_04" sourceRef="Catch_F1_Invitation" targetRef="EndEvent_F1"/>
  </bpmn:process>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Friend2" name="Friend 2 house building" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_F2_BuildRequest" name="Build request received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>F2_Flow_01</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_F2_BuildRequest" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_F2_BuildHouse" name="Build tree house">
      <bpmn:incoming>F2_Flow_01</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F2_Flow_02</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>
    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_F2_HouseBuilt" name="Report house built" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt">
      <bpmn:incoming>F2_Flow_02</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F2_Flow_03</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Catch_F2_Invitation" name="Party invitation received">
      <bpmn:incoming>F2_Flow_03</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>F2_Flow_04</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_F2_Invitation" messageRef="Msg_Invitation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_F2" name="Friend finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>F2_Flow_04</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2_Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_F2_BuildRequest" targetRef="Task_F2_BuildHouse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2_Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_F2_BuildHouse" targetRef="SendTask_F2_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2_Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_F2_HouseBuilt" targetRef="Catch_F2_Invitation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="F2_Flow_04" sourceRef="Catch_F2_Invitation" targetRef="EndEvent_F2"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_BuildingTreeHouse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/building-a-tree-house">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Requirements" name="Requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Draft" name="Draft plan"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefinedRequirements" name="Additional requirements"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_RefinedDraft" name="Refined draft plan"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_MaterialOrder" name="Material order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_OrderConfirmation" name="Order confirmation"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_BuildRequest" name="Build request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_HouseBuilt" name="House built"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_TreeHouse">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_You" name="You" processRef="Process_You"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Architect" name="Tree house architect"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Store1" name="Online store 1"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Store2" name="Online store 2"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Friends" name="Friends"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Requirements" name="Send requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_Requirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_Draft" name="Send draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RefinedRequirements" name="Send additional requirements" sourceRef="SendTask_RefinedRequirements" targetRef="Participant_Architect" messageRef="Msg_RefinedRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_RefinedDraft" name="Send refined draft" sourceRef="Participant_Architect" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_RefinedDraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_RefinedDraft"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderStore1" name="Order materials" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStore1" targetRef="Participant_Store1" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_OrderStore2" name="Order materials" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStore2" targetRef="Participant_Store2" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ConfirmStore1" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Store1" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_ConfirmStore2" name="Order confirmation" sourceRef="Participant_Store2" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_BuildRequest" name="Ask to build house" sourceRef="SendTask_BuildRequest" targetRef="Participant_Friends" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MF_HouseBuilt" name="Report house built" sourceRef="Participant_Friends" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_You" name="Building a tree house" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Build tree house started"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectRequirements" name="Collect requirements"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_Requirements" name="Send requirements" messageRef="Msg_Requirements"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_DraftReceived" name="Draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_DraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_Draft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Review_Merge" name="Draft received or refined"/>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_Draft_Check" name="Draft acceptable?" default="Flow_Refine"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_RefineDraft" name="Refine draft"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_RefinedRequirements" name="Send additional requirements" messageRef="Msg_RefinedRequirements"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_RefinedDraftReceived" name="Refined draft received">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_RefinedDraftReceived" messageRef="Msg_RefinedDraft"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateMaterialList" name="Create materials list"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CategorizeMaterials" name="Categorize materials"/>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Split" name="Start ordering and build request"/>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderStore1" name="Order materials" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed" name="Store 1 order confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Store1Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_OrderStore2" name="Order materials" messageRef="Msg_MaterialOrder"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed" name="Store 2 order confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_Store2Confirmed" messageRef="Msg_OrderConfirmation"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_BuildRequest" name="Send build request" messageRef="Msg_BuildRequest"/>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" name="House is built">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_HouseBuilt" messageRef="Msg_HouseBuilt"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_Order_Join" name="Join ordering and build request"/>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="ManualTask_SendInvitations" name="Send party invitations"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateAttendeeList" name="Create attendee list"/>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_BuySnacks" name="Buy snacks"/>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Party prepared"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_01" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="Task_CollectRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_02" sourceRef="Task_CollectRequirements" targetRef="SendTask_Requirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_03" sourceRef="SendTask_Requirements" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_DraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_04" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_DraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_05" sourceRef="Gateway_Review_Merge" targetRef="Gateway_Draft_Check"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Accepted" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_Draft_Check" targetRef="Task_CreateMaterialList">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${draftAccepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Refine" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_Draft_Check" targetRef="Task_RefineDraft"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_08" sourceRef="Task_RefineDraft" targetRef="SendTask_RefinedRequirements"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_09" sourceRef="SendTask_RefinedRequirements" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_RefinedDraftReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_RefinedDraftReceived" targetRef="Gateway_Review_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_CreateMaterialList" targetRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_CategorizeMaterials" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_13" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderStore1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_14" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_OrderStore2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_15" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Split" targetRef="SendTask_BuildRequest"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_16" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStore1" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_17" sourceRef="SendTask_OrderStore2" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_18" sourceRef="SendTask_BuildRequest" targetRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_19" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Store1Confirmed" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_20" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_Store2Confirmed" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_21" sourceRef="IntermediateCatch_HouseBuilt" targetRef="Gateway_Order_Join"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_22" sourceRef="Gateway_Order_Join" targetRef="ManualTask_SendInvitations"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_23" sourceRef="ManualTask_SendInvitations" targetRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_24" sourceRef="Task_CreateAttendeeList" targetRef="Task_BuySnacks"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_25" sourceRef="Task_BuySnacks" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
